o1: Enables MAP kinase kinase kinase activity; mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase binding activity; and protein serine/threonine/tyrosine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including defense response to other organism (including defense response to bacterium); determination of adult lifespan; and positive regulation of macromolecule biosynthetic process. Located in axon cytoplasm; neuronal cell body; and postsynaptic density. Is expressed in several structures, including AWC; hypodermis; intestine; rectal gland cell; and tail. Is part of p38 MAPK signaling pathway. Predicted to interact with SEK-1. Used to study amphetamine abuse; colibacillosis (DOID:9256); and enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli infection. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Huntington's disease. Orthologous to several human genes including MAP3K5 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 5).
